set_cap_valid_table_caps.stmt_pre: lemma set_cap_valid_table_caps: "\<lbrace>\<lambda>s. valid_table_caps s \<and> (is_pt_cap cap \<longrightarrow> cap_asid cap = None \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>r \<in> obj_refs cap. pts_of s r = Some (empty_pt (cap_pt_type cap))))\<rbrace> set_cap cap ptr \<lbrace>\<lambda>rv. valid_table_caps\<rbrace>"
set_cap_valid_table_caps.stmt_post: lemma set_cap_valid_table_caps: "\<lbrace>\<lambda>s. valid_table_caps s \<and> (is_pt_cap cap \<longrightarrow> cap_asid cap = None \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>r \<in> obj_refs cap. pts_of s r = Some (empty_pt (cap_pt_type cap))))\<rbrace> set_cap cap ptr \<lbrace>\<lambda>rv. valid_table_caps\<rbrace>"
